tools.name: get_fix
tools.why: Read before it touches any code. Names the files, states the checks it will be judged on, says when to stop early — and tells it which attempt this is, so it only does the part that is missing.

moments.title: You say "work the open fixes"
moments.detail: The agent calls list_open_fixes, picks the top one, and reads its instructions before touching anything.

moments.title: You paste a link from your channel
moments.detail: The id in the link is all it needs. get_fix returns the instructions; get_finding returns the evidence behind them if it wants to check the work is worth doing.

moments.title: It is about to change a file that already has a fix open against it
moments.detail: The skill we install tells it to check first, so two changes never land on the same surface at once and confuse the measurement.

moments.title: It says it is done
moments.detail: Nothing happens over this wire. We go and look at your repository and your events ourselves, because a completion message is a claim, not a fact.

skills.name: growthmind-fix
skills.does: how to receive a fix spec, work it, and claim it

skills.name: growthmind-instrument
skills.does: how to make a change measurable before shipping it

skills.name: growthmind-activation-sweep
skills.does: how to check a flow for dead ends before the pull request

skillsNote: This is the part most people miss. The tools tell your agent what is true. The skills tell it how to behave — and that is what stops it shipping a fix nobody can measure.
cannot: We never write code. All three tools are read-only, and read-only access to your repository is enough for the entire loop.
The agent cannot mark its own work done. It has no tool for it. We verify against your repository and your events, and only then does the clock start.
A fix spec contains no code. It names the files and says what must be true when you are finished. How to get there is your agent's job, not ours.
It cannot see another customer. The key is scoped to one workspace, and every read is filtered by it before it reaches the database.
